## Change / 修改内容

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link related issues or discussions.

## Compatibility / 兼容性

State the affected commands, profiles, protocol, persistent state or packages. Describe recovery for changes involving devices or storage.

## Verification / 验证

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish automation/simulation from a named board's results. For documentation-only changes, state that.

- [ ] Public documentation is consistent in English and Simplified Chinese where applicable.
- [ ] Sensitive data and unapproved binary inputs are excluded; author/source/license notices are preserved.
